d_voters.source: Assam Legislative Assembly reply by the Chief Minister (Home), 13.07.2026, as reported by The Assam Tribune
Lok Sabha Unstarred Question 2386, answered 03.12.2019, Ministry of Home Affairs
CEO Assam statement on the draft roll, 27.12.2025, as quoted by New Indian Express and India Today NE
Assam Legislative Assembly reply by the Chief Minister (Home), 13.07.2026, as reported by The Assam Tribune

rules.quote: the Commission has directed a Special Revision (SR) u/s 21 of the Representation of the Peoples Act 1950, with reference to 01.01.2026 as the qualifying date, in the State of Assam.
Not less than 18 years of age as on 01.01.2026;

rules.assam: BLO visits each household with a pre-filled register (Statement-1) of existing electors to verify or correct; at least three visits to a locked house
rules.quote: For field verification, the BLOs will be given a pre-filled BLO register (Statement-1) containing the details of existing electors in their respective part for H2H field visit. The household is the basic unit for conducting the house-to-house survey and to get the said details verified/corrected from the electors or the head of the household as mentioned in the Statement-1. ... If BLO finds that any house is locked or closed at the time of visit, she/he shall at least make three visits to get the verification done.
rules.sir: Every elector given a pre-printed enumeration form to fill, sign and return; a name whose form is not returned is left off the draft

rules.assam: None. The order names no enumeration form; the BLO fills Statement-1 (existing electors), Statement-2 (un-enrolled eligible citizens) and Statement-3 (prospective electors) and gets Form 6, 7 or 8 filled where needed
rules.quote: BLOs will collect the following information - a) Multiple entries/dead electors/Permanently Shifted Electors in Statement 1 b) Correction in the ER entries in Statement 1. c) Un-enrolled eligible citizens in Statement 2. d) Prospective electors ... in Statement 3. ii. BLOs will get the requisite Form 6,7,8 filled from the citizen/elector.
rules.sir: Modified Enumeration Form (Annexure III) asking for details of the elector or a relative in the last SIR roll

rules.assam: None asked for. The order lists no document for an existing elector and no link to an earlier roll
rules.quote: (no paragraph asks an existing elector for a document)
rules.sir: No document during enumeration; after the draft, notices to electors not linked with the last SIR roll, who then show documents from the list (11 documents, Aadhaar, Bihar SIR extract)

rules.assam: None. The order does not mention the 2005 roll or any earlier roll
rules.sir: Assam listed with last SIR qualifying date 01.01.2005 in Annexure V of the 27.10.2025 order, though Assam was not in Phase II

rules.assam: Kept out of the verification register; carried forward to the draft unchanged; removed or changed only on an order of a Foreigners Tribunal or a court
rules.quote: D-Voters: The details of D-Voters shall not be included in Statement-I, as no verification is required in their case. All related particulars (such as name, age, photograph, etc.) of D-Voters shall be carried forward to the draft electoral roll without any change. Any modification, including removal or deletion, shall be made only upon receipt of an order from the competent Foreigners' Tribunal or an appropriate court of law.
rules.sir: Not applicable (D-voter category exists only in Assam)

rules.assam: Not mentioned. The order says nothing about the National Register of Citizens or people left out of it
Form 6 as in an ordinary revision; Aadhaar voluntary
rules.quote: Every claim for inclusion of name in the roll as new elector shall be in Form-6. ... The applicant can voluntarily furnish his/her Aadhaar Number in Form-6 and Form-8. However, no application for inclusion of name in electoral roll shall be denied and no entries in electoral roll shall be deleted for inability of an individual to furnish or intimate Aadhaar Number.
rules.sir: Form 6 with a Declaration Form (Annexure IV) asking for last-SIR roll details; documents on notice by birth cohort

rules.assam: Multiple entries, dead and permanently shifted electors removed through Form 7 before the draft
rules.quote: 100% removal of multiple entries/Dead electors/Permanently Shifted electors through Form-7.
rules.sir: Names whose enumeration form was not collected left off the draft, with a probable reason (absent, shifted, dead, duplicate) and booth-wise lists published

rules.assam: Death deletions need certificate or Form 7; shifting needs Form 8; ERO cross-checks polling stations with deletions over 2% and objectors with more than 5 objections; 10% field check of non-death deletions
rules.quote: Deletions in polling stations where the number of deletions exceed 2% of the total electors in the voters' list of the polling stations. ii. Deletions where the same person is the objector in more than 5 cases.

rules.aspect: no suo motu deletion after draft
rules.assam: ERO/AERO may not delete a draft entry without a fair and reasonable opportunity; personal notice for proposed deletion other than death
rules.quote: ERO/AERO shall not suo-moto delete any entry from the draft roll without giving a fair and reasonable opportunity to the persons concerned whose names have appeared in the draft roll.
rules.sir: Same rule in the SIR orders

rules.assam: Not printed for parties; generated and kept by EROs
rules.quote: No separate addition, deletion and modification lists will be printed and given to the political parties, though the EROs will generate these lists from ERO-Net and keep them only for future reference.
rules.sir: Booth-wise lists of names not in the draft displayed and put on the CEO website

rules.assam: First appeal to the District Magistrate, second to the CEO (s.24 RPA 1950, rule 27)
rules.quote: an appeal shall lie from any decision of the ERO to the District Magistrate u/s 24(a) of the RP Act, 1950, and a second appeal under Section 24(b) ... shall lie to the CEO

rules.assam: No polling station over 1,200 electors without the Commission's approval
rules.quote: no Polling station has more than 1,200 electors, except with the prior approval of the Commission.

rules.assam: A BLA may file no more than 10 forms a day; over 30 in the claims period, the ERO or AERO cross-verifies them
rules.quote: a BLA shall not submit more than 10 Forms to BLO at one time/in one day. iii. If a BLA files more than 30 Applications/Forms during the entire period of filing claims and objections, then the cross verification must be done by ERO/AERO themselves.
rules.sir: Bihar order of 24.06.2025: up to 50 forms a day before the draft and 10 a day after

schedule.activity: Printing of documents and circulars, training of election officials
H2H verification through BLOs; rationalisation of polling stations; removal of discrepancies in roll/EPIC
Preparation of Formats 1 to 8; preparation of integrated draft roll
Publication of integrated draft electoral roll
Period for filing claims and objections
Special campaign dates (Saturdays and Sundays within claims period, fixed by CEO)
Health parameters checked, Commission's permission for final publication, supplements printed
